entities.summary: The Church of Pentecost is a Pentecostal denomination that originates from Ghana. The Church currently has a presence in 198 countries globally. Its current Chairman, who happens to be its highest officer worldwide, is Apostle Eric Nyamekye. Church of Pentecost is a religious denomination in Africa, established in 1962-08-01.
